lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly horizontal rows along the lateral flank. A prominent cluster of three spots forms a triangular configuration just posterior to the fifth gill slit, positioned midway between the primary dorsal ridge and the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of lighter pigmentation are visible in the mid-flank region, intersecting with horizontal rows of white spots to create a rectangular grid-like pattern where the nodes are defined by the spot centroids.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank. Each exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge, extending from the posterior head region towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, distinct high-luminance blobs irregularly spaced across its lateral surface, with approximately 12 discrete points visible within the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, tightly packed high-luminance points compared to the larger, more widely spaced spots on the posterior flank.
